intent: Inspect and refactor R2dbcTelemetryLedgerRepository without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. @Repository implementing TelemetryLedgerRepository with R2dbcEntityTemplate/DatabaseClient (constructor(R2dbcEntityTemplate)); INSERT only, never UPDATE/DELETE. Queries: latest by recordId ordered revision_number desc limit 1; revisions ordered by revision_number asc; history filtered by device, metric, t_device range ordered by t_device. Unique (record_id, revision_number) violation surfaces as an error. Works on PostgreSQL and the H2 substitute.
